title: Wildfire Smoke and Extreme Heat Action Plan - Canada
description: The Action Plan is an individualized health communication tool, providing a checklist of steps for evidence-informed readiness and guidance on actions before and during wildfire smoke and extreme heat events. A provider instructional guide is available to support the clinician through the completion of the form, providing answers to common questions and links to public-facing resources. A community organization instructional guide is intended to support a community organization working with a client through the steps of the plan, with annotations in sections where a healthcare provider?s advice is strongly recommended.
